news.headline: The market could fall 10-12% — stocks to buy and sell now
news.summary: Carter Worth, CEO, Worth Charting warns that overcrowded defensive trades have left the S&P 500 vulnerable to a 10% to 12% year-end drop—and shares why he’s taking profits on consumer staples like Coca-Cola and Costco while buying oversold bounces in Nvidia and Caterpillar alongside strong charts like John Deere and Amazon.
